cohort: The study included 3,907 pregnant women (1,925 in the 75g OGTT group and 1,982 in the 100g OGTT group) who underwent GDM screening at Tongchuan People's Hospital.
finding: Under the International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) criteria, no significant differences in GDM diagnostic efficacy or the risks of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes were observed between the 75g and 100g oral glucose tolerance tests.
